name: Elverson Supply
description: Elverson Supply on East Main Street is the counter you walk up to when you need the part today, not a tracking number.

hero.headline: The hardware run that still works
hero.sub: Elverson Supply on East Main Street is the counter you walk up to when you need the part today, not a tracking number.

story.heading: A supply house with a memory
paragraphs: We know the jobs around here. Tell us the brand on the box and we will find the piece that matches.
Contractors and homeowners use the same counter. Everyone gets the same honest answer about what is in stock.
Elverson Supply serves people who live and work in Elverson.
You'll find the phone and the next step on this page, not buried in a menu.
Come in when you're ready. We'll make the visit straightforward.

feature.heading: In stock beats overnight
feature.text: If we have it, you can have it this afternoon. If we do not, we will say so and tell you the next move.

spotlight.heading: 101 East Main Street
spotlight.text: Elverson is small enough that you will not miss the door. Come in with the old part in your hand.

contact.heading: Ask the counter
contact.sub: Call with the part number or a photo. We will check the shelf.
